title: Community OpTaskAir
description: Community standard schema for a simulation Op Task Air.  This describes the environment along with who is present and their intended plan.

schema.description: Fixed identifier confirming this is a community-op-task-air document.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the schema this file conforms to. Parsers should reject files whose major version exceeds their supported major.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this Op Task Air (UUID).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this plan was first created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last modification. Null if never updated after creation.

tool_source.description: Free-form user-agent string identifying the tool and version that produced this file (e.g. 'MCToolbox/1.2.0').

coalition.description: The coalition this Op Task Air belongs to.

package.description: A flight asset participating in the package.

assets.description: A flight asset participating in the package.

routes.description: Route definitions. Each Asset references one route by route_id.

waypoints.description: List of waypoints available for use in route legs. Each RouteLeg references a waypoint by start_waypoint and end_waypoint

tracks.description: Track definitions. Each waypoint can optionally references a track by track_id.

airfields.description: Definitions of non-standard or custom airfields / operating locations used in this plan (road bases, carriers, FARPs, etc.). Standard ICAO airfields do not need an entry here.

MissionContext.description: Anchors the plan in time, space, and environment.

theatre.description: Map / theatre name as recognised by the target sim.

date.description: Mission UTC date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

time_seconds.description: Mission start time expressed as seconds elapsed since midnight (UTC real-world time).

bullseye.description: Bullseye reference points per coalition. Null if not used.

Weather.description: Meteorological conditions for the mission. Null if unknown or not applicable.

winds.description: Wind layers. Surface wind required; altitude layers optional.

altitude.description: Upper wind layers ordered by ascending altitude.

altitude_ft.description: Altitude MSL in feet at which this wind layer applies.

base_ft.description: Cloud base altitude MSL in feet.

WindLayer.description: A single wind observation at a given level.

from_deg.description: Wind direction in degrees true (the direction the wind is coming FROM).

altitude_ft.description: Altitude MSL in feet (present only in altitude wind layer entries).

Package.description: Groups assets into a tactical unit and holds shared comms and intel references.

package_commander.description: Callsign of the package commander / mission commander.

comms_plan.description: Ordered list of communications entries shared across the package.

notes.description: Free-text planning notes for the package.

label.description: Human-readable label for the channel (e.g. 'STRIKE COMMON', 'MAGIC 1').

callsign.description: Callsign of the station on this frequency (e.g. 'MAGIC', 'SHELL 1').

Asset.description: A flight asset participating in the package.

package_id.description: Unique identifier of the package the asset belongs to.

tactical_callsign.description: Tactical callsign, if blank assumed to be the same as callsign (e.g. 'VIPER 1').

flight_number.description: The number of expected flight members for an asset.

flight_type.description: ICAO Compliant Flight Type value (S=Scheduled air service, N=Non-scheduled air transport, G=General aviation, M=Military, X=Other than the above)

flight_rules.description: ICAO Compliant Flight Rules value (I=IFR, V=VFR, Y=IFR then VFR, Z=VFR then IFR).  Applied to whole route if not specified on a leg-by-leg basis.

flight_oversight.description: Flight environment visibility - Public=Any consumer may display this leg.  Restricted=Consumers should restrict visibility according to their authorisation model.  Classified=Consumers should not disclose the leg except to explicitly authorised users.  Applied to whole route if not specified on a leg-by-leg basis.

control_type.description: Identifies whether the asset's flight members are currently controlled by a human participant or by AI.  Can be overridden at the flight_member level.

flight_members.description: List of flight members, if known, that belong to an asset.

primary_target.description: Free-text description of the primary target or objective.

dmpi_refs.description: Array of DMPI coordinates assigned to this package.

route_id.description: Reference to the Route object (routes[].id) for this asset.

notes.description: Free-text notes specific to this asset (e.g. stores load, special instructions).

Flight_Member.description: One entry per flight member in the asset.

onboard_number.description: DCS onboard number (used for kneeboard and DTC generation).

pilot_name.description: Pilot's callsign or name for personalisation.

control_type.description: Identifies whether the flight member is currently controlled by a human participant or by AI.  Supersedes control_type at the asset level if supplied.

Transponder.description: IFF transponder settings. Null if not applicable.

mode_s.description: Mode S hex address (6 hex digits). '000000' = inactive.

Codes.description: Additional IFF and weapon guidance codes. Null if not applicable.

laser_pulse.description: Laser pulse repetition frequency identifier if required.

sadl_id.description: SADL / JTIDS track identity for A-10 / F-15E coordination.

Route.description: Sequence of legs used by an asset.

asset_id.description: Reference back to the Asset (assets[].id) that flies this route.

tot_offset_seconds.description: Offset in seconds from the package TOT reference used to stagger assets. Negative = early.

initial_fuel_lbs.description: Planned initial fuel load in pounds.

legs.description: List of legs that make the total route.

RouteLeg.description: A navigational leg connecting two waypoints.

leg_name.description: Unique name for this leg within the route

start_waypoint.description: Reference to the starting Waypoint object (waypoints[].id) for this leg.

end_waypoint.description: Reference to the ending Waypoint object (waypoints[].id) for this leg.

flight_rules.description: ICAO Compliant Flight Rules value (I=IFR, V=VFR, Y=IFR then VFR, Z=VFR then IFR).  Overrides Asset level value for this leg only.

flight_oversight.description: Flight environment visibility - Public=Any consumer may display this leg.  Restricted=Consumers should restrict visibility according to their authorisation model.  Classified=Consumers should not disclose the leg except to explicitly authorised users.  Overrides Asset level value for this leg only.

Waypoint.description: A single navigation point on a route.

type.description: Semantic type of this waypoint. CUSTOM allows tool-specific types described in the notes field.

track_id.description: Reference to a Track object (tracks[].id) for this waypoint.

custom_type.description: When type is CUSTOM, a free-text label describing the waypoint purpose.

name.description: Human-readable waypoint name or identifier (e.g. 'IP ALPHA', 'UGKO').

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). Positive = North.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). Positive = East.

altitude_ft.description: Planned altitude in feet. Null if not altitude-constrained (e.g. a ground point).

altitude_ref.description: Altitude reference: mean sea level (MSL), above ground level (AGL), or flight level (FL).

speed_type.description: Speed type qualifier.  Null if speed unconstrained.

eta_seconds.description: Estimated time of arrival at this waypoint in seconds since midnight (UTC real-world time).

fixed_seconds.description: Hard time-on-point in seconds since midnight

leave_seconds.description: Time expected to leave this waypoint in seconds since midnight

track_deg.description: Planned track / heading in degrees true from this waypoint.

activity.description: Short description of what occurs at this waypoint (e.g. 'Commence attack run', 'Begin CAP racetrack').

notes.description: Extended free-text notes for this waypoint.

tacan_ref.description: TACAN station identifier associated with this waypoint (e.g. '12X' for a tanker or navaid).

airfield_ref.description: Reference to an airfield at this waypoint. For standard ICAO aerodromes use the 4-character code (e.g. 'UGKO'). For custom/non-standard locations use the UUID of an entry in the top-level airfields array.

Track.description: A track that one or more assets can use.

fix_name.description: Name of the initial fix for this track, if known.

initial_bearing.description: The True bearing to enter this track.

initial_altitude.description: The altitude in feet to enter this track.

altitude_seperation.description: The altitude in feet between each stacked aircraft.

track_length.description: The length in nautical miles of this track.

track_width.description: The width in nautical miles of this track.

points.description: A list of outer coordinates that define this tracks shape, starting with the entry.

LatLon.description: A geographic coordinate pair (WGS-84 decimal degrees).

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Positive = North.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Positive = East.

Extensions.description: Tool-specific extension data. Each key is a tool namespace (e.g. 'mctoolbox', 'lotatc', 'dcs_dtc'). Parsers from other tools must silently ignore namespaces they do not recognise.

additionalProperties.description: Tool-specific payload. Internal structure is defined by the owning tool.

kneeboard_template.description: Name of the kneeboard template to use when generating kneeboards from this plan.

intel_picture_hash.description: Hash of the Intel picture snapshot at the time of export, for consistency checking.

op_id.description: MCToolbox Operation ID this plan belongs to.

mission_id.description: MCToolbox Mission ID this plan belongs to.

lotatc.description: LotATC-specific extension data for GCI picture generation.

detection_range_m.description: Distance radius of maximum radar detection in metres.

threat_range_m.description: Distance radius of threat in metres.

rcs.description: Radar cross-section value for this unit.

is_carrier.description: Marks this asset as a carrier (enables approach / marshal procedures in LotATC).

track_number.description: LotATC track number (TN) for this asset.

radar.description: Radar parameters for assets that have an emitting radar.

dcs_dtc.description: DCS-DTC / native DTC export extension data.

mfd_pages.description: MFD page configuration, structure depends on airframe.

AirfieldDefinition.description: Definition of a non-standard or custom airfield / operating location.

id.description: Unique identifier for this airfield definition, used as the airfield_ref value on waypoints.

name.description: Human-readable name (e.g. 'Valtatie 4 Strip', 'CVN-71 Theodore Roosevelt', 'FARP EAGLE').

icao_code.description: ICAO code if one exists. Null for road bases, FARPs, carriers, and other non-ICAO locations.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). For carriers, the planned position at mission start.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS-84). For carriers, the planned position at mission start.

elevation_ft.description: Elevation above MSL in feet. Typically 0 for carriers.

magnetic_variation_deg.description: Local magnetic variation in degrees. Positive = East, negative = West.

runways.description: Runway or landing surface definitions at this location.

carrier.description: Carrier-specific properties. Populated only when type is CARRIER.

course_deg.description: Planned Base Recovery Course (BRC) in degrees true.

link4a_frequency_mhz.description: Link 4A datalink frequency in MHz for ACLS.

marshal_frequency_mhz.description: Marshal / approach control frequency in MHz.

deck_state.description: Planned deck state at recovery time.

road_base.description: Road base / highway strip specific properties. Populated only when type is ROAD_BASE.

road_name.description: Road or highway designation (e.g. 'Valtatie 4', 'E18 Kotka Strip').

usable_length_m.description: Usable landing/take-off run in metres after obstacles are cleared.

obstacles_cleared.description: Whether road furniture has been cleared for the exercise.

farp.description: FARP-specific properties. Populated only when type is FARP.

comms.description: Communications channels for this airfield (tower, ground, approach, LSO, etc.).

RunwayDefinition.description: A single runway, landing strip, or carrier landing spot.

track_deg.description: True heading of the landing direction.

surface.description: Surface type. Use DECK for carrier landing areas.

ils_frequency_mhz.description: ILS localiser frequency in MHz. Null if no ILS.

ils_course_deg.description: ILS inbound course in degrees true.
